# Click wheel (`click-wheel`)

Large rotary wheel with ticks.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createClickWheel` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/clickWheel.d.ts`): `.mh-click-wheel`: a large rotary wheel with ticks, turned like a physical knob. It moves by detents (one stepeach, `detents` per turn) relative to where the turn started, so it never jumps to the finger; the ticks turn withit and an arc on the rim shows where a bounded value sits. The `__wheel` is a `role="slider"`: drag around it,scroll over it, or use the arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End. An optional `__center` button sits in themiddle. Parts `__wheel`, `__svg`, `__disc`, `__rim`, `__progress`, `__ticks`, `__tick`, `__indicator`,`__value`, `__center`, `__label`.

```ts
export function createClickWheel(options: ClickWheelOptions): ClickWheelHandle;

export interface ClickWheelOptions {
  /** Visible label under the wheel. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** Default 0. */
  min?: number;
  /** Default 100. */
  max?: number;
  /** One detent. Default 1. */
  step?: number;
  /** Page Up / Page Down; default ten steps. */
  bigStep?: number;
  value?: number;
  /** Past one end comes back at the other (an hour of the day, a list). `max` then equals `min`. */
  wrap?: boolean;
  /** Detents (and ticks) per full turn. Default 24. */
  detents?: number;
  format?: (value: number) => string;
  /** Shows the value in the middle (when there's no centre button). Default true. */
  showValue?: boolean;
  /** A button in the middle (play, confirm). */
  center?: ClickWheelCenter;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large';
  /** A short vibration on each detent, where the device supports it. */
  haptics?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** On every detent. */
  onInput?: (value: number, event: Event) => void;
  /** When a turn ends (let go, a key, a scroll notch). */
  onChange?: (value: number, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface ClickWheelHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** The `role="slider"` wheel that takes focus. */
  wheel: HTMLDivElement;
  center: HTMLButtonElement | null;
  getValue(): number;
  setValue(value: number): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createClickWheel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const timer = createClickWheel({
  label: 'Timer',
  max: 120,
  step: 5,
  value: 25,
  detents: 36,
  format: (v) => `${v} min`,
  center: {
    label: 'Start timer',
    icon: 'play',
    onPress: () => (status.textContent = `Timer started: ${timer.getValue()} min`),
  },
});

document.body.append(timer.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ClickWheel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ClickWheelExample() {
  const [minutes, setMinutes] = useState(25);
  const [started, setStarted] = useState<number | null>(null);
  return (
    <div>
      <ClickWheel
        label="Timer"
        max={120}
        step={5}
        detents={36}
        format={(v) => `${v} min`}
        value={minutes}
        onValueChange={setMinutes}
        center={{ label: 'Start timer', icon: 'play', onPress: () => setStarted(minutes) }}
      />
      {started !== null && <p>Timer started: {started} min</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```
